name: reflection-fixture
description: R50-PARALLAX reflection fixtures (quality/fixtures/reflection/): a denoised flat lightmap and automatically placed reflection probes (RPRB) rendered with the gi-reference Cycles light paths at mirror-fidelity resolution, so engine captures of their mirror floors can be judged against Cycles renders of the same cameras (tools/quality/reflection_runtime.py). No probe volume, directional page or pipeline reference render. Baked and rendered on the CPU, so the fixtures do not depend on the host GPU's HIP compute (which wedged on 2026-09-25 and hung every Cycles GPU job).
